requestSnapshot.title: Adapt BOS Agent Governance in Symphony coordinators

requirements: Deliver opt-in planning and implementation committees using a pinned catalog, independent reviewers and arbiter, durable recovery and authorized continuation.

Verify the canonical catalog against authoritative BOS context; the original request references commit 1682995de8d50361eba262fdacb51e98669c9cc1. Resolve any difference through authoritative verification rather than silently substituting a revision.
Record applicability decisions for all ten committees using the verified catalog definitions.
Enforce independent readOnly review and an independent arbiter through verified execution identities and scoped permissions.
Allow two committee rounds; require prior justification and an independent exception receipt before a third round. Permit no fourth round.
Preserve durable operation identities, completed committee decisions and aggregate Goal budgets across recovery.
Preserve the legacy workflow for Issues outside governance opt-in.
Use existing Symphony coordinators and portable host configuration, keeping credentials outside the repository.
Require authoritative readiness and existing Goal authorization before implementation continuation.
Exclude production, global enablement and closure of the originating BOS MCP issue.
